name: ai_chat_mvp
title: AI Chat Assistant MVP
description: Build a minimal viable AI chat assistant that allows users to have conversations with Claude. Core value: natural language interaction with context retention across a session. Tight scope focused on shipping the core loop within 2 weeks.

requirements.description: Single-turn and multi-turn conversation with Claude API
Message history display with user and assistant message bubbles
Streaming response display with typing indicator
Error handling for network failures with retry option
First response token must appear within 500ms of send
Support conversation context up to 100k tokens

constraints: MVP scope only - no persistence, no accounts, no sharing
